user_query: I want to display all the work items in a sorted order on my portfolio website.

TaskList.description: Retrieve all work items from the database.
Sort the retrieved work items in descending order based on a specified attribute.
Retrieve web data related to the work items.
Sort the retrieved web data in ascending order based on a specified attribute.
Combine the sorted work items and web data, including title, image URL, framework, and link for each item.
